lines.japanese: ピィ────、ヒョロロロロ……
lines.english: Peeeeee—wheeree-ree-ree…

lines.japanese: そのとき、どこかから懐かしい音が聞こえた。ああ、本当に久しぶりだ。これは……グレタガルドの……。
lines.english: Then, from somewhere, came a sound I knew from long ago. Ah, it had been so long. This was... Gretagard's...

lines.japanese: 馴染みぶかい金色の粒子が徐々に僕の身を包みこむ。
lines.english: Familiar motes of gold slowly enveloped me.

lines.japanese: 燦々と、爛々と、閃々と、この世界を、輝く粒子が埋めつくしていく。
lines.english: Blazing, brilliant, scintillant—the shining particles spread until they filled this world.

lines.japanese: しゃんしゃんしゃん、しゃんしゃんしゃん
lines.english: Jingle, jingle, jingle. Jingle, jingle, jingle.

lines.japanese: しゃんしゃんしゃんしゃんしゃんしゃんしゃん
lines.english: Jingle, jingle, jingle, jingle, jingle, jingle, jingle.

lines.japanese: 僕の友達の声が聞こえる。でも、それも徐々に遠ざかっていく。
lines.english: I could hear my friends' voices. Little by little, they too receded.

lines.japanese: はっきりと聞こえるのに、体から離れていく感覚。そうだ、あの声は誰のものだったかな。
lines.english: I heard them clearly, yet felt them drawing away from my body. Yes... whose voice had that been?

lines.japanese: もうすぐだ、僕の体はこの世界を離れて、遥か遠くグレタガルドの地へ――
lines.english: Soon. Soon my body would leave this world for the distant land of Gretagard—

lines.japanese: そして、世界が白に染まった。
lines.english: Then the world was dyed white.
Bells...?

lines.japanese: じゃあ、ここは、どこかの修道院なんだろうか……。
lines.english: So... was this some monastery?

lines.japanese: それは確かに僕の耳に入ってきているにも関わらず、体の内から響くように、徐々に膨らんできていた。
lines.english: The sound unquestionably entered through my ears, yet it swelled by degrees as though ringing from inside my body.

lines.japanese: 何だろう、違う、これはいつもの召喚とは違う……もっと、高くへ昇っていく感覚。
lines.english: What was this? No. This was different from the usual summons... I was rising higher. Far higher.

lines.japanese: 白い雲が空に吸いこまれていくように天高く巻きあげられ、僕はその中を、何かを求めるように突きすすんだ。
lines.english: White clouds streamed upward, drawn into the heavens. I drove through them as if in search of something.

lines.japanese: 見える……耳だけじゃなく、視界にも何かが映っている。
lines.english: I could see... Something had entered not only my hearing, but my sight.

lines.japanese: 両足が固い地面を知覚したかと思うと、僕の体は長く伸びた赤い絨毯の上に立っていた。
lines.english: The instant my feet sensed solid ground, I found myself standing on a long red carpet.

lines.japanese: 「ここは……ベルツモンドの修道院か！？」
lines.english: “Is this... the monastery at Belzmonde?!”

lines.japanese: 「おはろーん、ご機嫌いかがマイブロウ」
lines.english: “Mornelloon! How’s it going, my bro?”

lines.japanese: 「何者だ！」
lines.english: “Who goes there?!”

lines.japanese: 後ろからの声に振りかえると、そこにはひい、ふう、みい……全部で四つの扉があった。
lines.english: I turned toward the voice behind me. There stood one, two, three... four doors in all.

lines.japanese: その右から二番目の扉の前に、身長が僕と同じくらいの男性が立っている。
lines.english: A man about my own height stood before the second door from the right.

lines.japanese: 誰だろう。僕はこのひとを知っているような、だけどこんなひとは知らないはずだと、頭のどこかが本能を抑えこむ。
lines.english: Who was he? Some part of me felt I knew him, but somewhere in my mind, a voice insisting I could not know this man held that instinct down.

lines.japanese: 「いやー、そんな面白いしゃべり方しなくてもいいでしょ。常時そういうしゃべり方をしてるっていうんなら別だけどね」
lines.english: “Come on, you don’t have to talk in that funny way. Unless that’s how you talk all the time, I guess.”
“Wait...”

lines.japanese: まるで現代人のような服装。グレタガルドの世界の中で、こんなひとは初めて見る。
lines.english: He was dressed like a man of the modern world. I had never seen anyone like him in Gretagard.

lines.japanese: 「君は一体何者なんだ」
lines.english: “Who are you?”

lines.japanese: 「はい、相手の名前を聞くときはまず自分から。これ、万国共通の礼儀だよ」
lines.english: All right, if you want to know someone's name, you give yours first. That's basic manners anywhere in the world.

lines.japanese: 「む、なるほど……私の名は、聖騎士ホーク・シアンブルー。グレタガルド王家に使える四騎士の一人……だ……」
lines.english: “Mm. Of course... My name is Hawk Cyan-Blue, holy knight and one of the four knights who serve the royal house of Gretagard...”

lines.japanese: 話の途中から、その男のひとは、お腹を抱えこむように前かがみになった。どうしたんだろう、下痢でもしてるのかな。
lines.english: Halfway through my introduction, the man doubled over as though clutching his stomach. What was wrong? Did he have diarrhea?

lines.japanese: 「くっ、すまない。私は聖騎士と言えど、回復魔法は持ちあわせていないんだ……だが、街の道具屋に行けば、必ず薬草や毒消し薬が売っているはず……」
lines.english: “Forgive me. Holy knight though I am, I possess no healing magic... But an item shop in town is certain to sell medicinal herbs and antidotes...”

lines.japanese: 「わ、笑うな、笑うな俺っ……頑張れ俺！　ここで笑ったら負けだ俺！」
lines.english: “D-don’t laugh. Don’t laugh... Come on, hold it together! If I laugh now, I lose!”

lines.japanese: 「あっはははは、腹イテー。出来れば隼人君に聞かせて、その表情を観察したい。やー、眼福眼福」
lines.english: “Ahahahaha! My stomach hurts. I wish Hayato could hear this. I'd love to study the look on his face. Ah, a feast for the eyes.”

lines.japanese: な、何だろう……笑ってるみたいだけど、もしかしてワライダケでも食べて、猛毒に侵されているのかもしれない。
lines.english: Wh-what was happening...? He appeared to be laughing, but perhaps he had eaten a laughing mushroom and fallen prey to its deadly poison.

lines.japanese: 「き、君！　下手をすれば命に関わるから、早く薬屋に行った方が……！」
lines.english: “Y-you there! This may be fatal. You must hurry to an apothecary!”

lines.japanese: 「聖騎士様、聖騎士様、まずはご自分の服装を確認されてはいかがでしょうか」
lines.english: “Sir Holy Knight, Sir Holy Knight. Might I suggest that you begin by examining your own attire?”

lines.japanese: 「えっ」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 言われてから、僕はあることに気がついた。今日の装備はやけに軽い。よく見れば、剣も盾も、鎧すらもない。
lines.english: Only after he said it did I notice: my equipment felt strangely light today. Looking closer, I found neither sword nor shield—not even armor.

lines.japanese: この白のブレザーは……美空学園の学生服じゃないか！
lines.english: This white blazer... It was my uniform from Misora Academy!

lines.japanese: 「え、えっ……これって……」
lines.english: “Wh-what...? This is...”

lines.japanese: 「ほんじゃ、改めて」
lines.english: “All right. Let's try that again.”

lines.japanese: 目の前の男のひとはひょいひょいと軽い感じで近づいてくると、片手を上げて親しみやすいフランクな微笑みを浮かべた。
lines.english: The man came over with a light, easy step, raised one hand, and gave me a friendly, relaxed smile.

lines.japanese: 「こんばんは！」
lines.english: “Good evening!”

lines.japanese: 「羽田家三男、千歳鷲介です！　好きなものはフリッキー５、苦手なものはきんきんクールビューティー。得意な下着はベージュ。最近失恋したんで、取り扱いは慎重に！」
lines.english: “Shusuke Chitose, third son of the Haneda family! I like Fricky Five; I don’t do ice-cold beauties. My best underwear is beige. I just had my heart broken, so handle with care!”

lines.japanese: 「はいじゃあ、次は君の番」
lines.english: “All right, now it's your turn.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 状況もつかめないままに、僕は自己紹介を促された。え、ええと、こんなのやったことないからよく分からないな。
lines.english: Before I could grasp the situation, I was being prompted to introduce myself. Um... I had never done anything like this. I wasn't sure how.

lines.japanese: 「え、ええと、羽田鷹志……です。美空学園の三年生です」
lines.english: U-um... I'm Takashi Haneda. A third-year at Misora Academy.

lines.japanese: 「好きなものは！」
lines.english: “Favorite thing!”

lines.japanese: 「ささやきマテリアルの穂乃香です」
lines.english: “Honoka from *Whisper Material*.”

lines.japanese: 「苦手なものは！」
lines.english: “Least favorite!”

lines.japanese: 「キュウリやトマトなんかの野菜です」
lines.english: “Vegetables. Cucumbers and tomatoes and things.”

lines.japanese: 「得意な下着は！」
lines.english: “Your best underwear!”

lines.japanese: 「ブリーフです」
lines.english: “Briefs.”

lines.japanese: 「そこ違うだろオイィ！」
lines.english: “That's not what I meant, dammit!”

lines.japanese: 「あはは」
lines.english: “Ahaha.”

lines.japanese: 面白いひとだ。初対面なのになんだか話しやすくて、こんなひとと会うのは初めてかもしれない。
lines.english: He was funny. We had only just met, yet he was curiously easy to talk to. Perhaps I had never met anyone like him.

lines.japanese: 「ていうか兄弟同士の漫才ほどサムいものないって。どうよ、どうなのよ羽田三兄弟」
lines.english: “Anyway, nothing bombs harder than a comedy routine between brothers. What do you make of that, the three Haneda brothers?”
“What?”

lines.japanese: さっきから聞きたいことは山ほどあるけど、一番気になっていることは彼が最初に口にした一言だ。僕は親しみの中に警戒も込めつつ、訊ねてみた。
lines.english: I had more questions than I could count, but what troubled me most was one of the first words he had used. With caution mingled into my growing ease, I asked him.

lines.japanese: 「兄弟って言いますけど、僕の兄弟は小鳩しかいませんよ」
lines.english: “You keep saying we're brothers, but Kobato is my only sibling.”

lines.japanese: 「あれま」
lines.english: “Well, now.”

lines.japanese: 意外そうな顔で返された。もしかして、僕の知らない生き別れの……なんて、アニメみたいな話。
lines.english: He looked surprised. Maybe I had some long-lost... Nah, that was the kind of thing that only happened in anime.

lines.japanese: あ、もしかして羽田邸の開かずの間って……。
lines.english: Wait. That room no one ever opened in the Haneda house... Could it be...?

lines.japanese: 彼はふっと前髪を息で吹きあげたあと、腕を組みながら、くいくいと指を動かした。
lines.english: He puffed his bangs upward, folded his arms, and crooked one finger at me several times.

lines.japanese: 「あーなるほど。おっけおっけ、今のタカシ君の状態が分かっちゃったかも。もうちょい情報が必要だけどね」
lines.english: Ahh, got it. Okay, okay, I think I might know what's going on with you now, Takashi. Still need a little more info, though.

lines.japanese: 「タカシ君、質問されたとこで悪いんだけど、しばらくはこっちの質問に答えてくれるかな。そうすれば、君の疑問に対する答えにもなるからさ」
lines.english: “Sorry to answer your question with questions, Takashi, but could you answer mine for a little while? They ought to answer your own questions too.”
“I suppose...”

lines.japanese: 「問１．君はここに来る前に、何か嫌なことがあった」
lines.english: “Question one. Something unpleasant happened before you came here.”

lines.japanese: 「そ、そんなことないですよ。ただ、ええと……渡来さんが何か勘違いしてただけで……」
lines.english: “N-no, nothing like that. It's only... Watarai misunderstood something...”

lines.japanese: 「はあ、渡来さんねーえ。ああ、あのびっくりしちゃうくらい綺麗な子」
lines.english: “Ah, Watarai. The girl so beautiful it takes you by surprise.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、はい。そのひとです」
lines.english: “Yes. That's her.”

lines.japanese: びっくりしちゃうような綺麗な子。こんなシンプルな表現で誰だか特定できちゃうひとも珍しい。
lines.english: A girl so beautiful it takes you by surprise. You don't get many people you can identify from something that simple.

lines.japanese: 「ふぅーん、あの子ったら何をしでかしてくれたのかしらん。ま、悪い子じゃなさそうだったけどね。んじゃ、問２．ここに来た時はグレタガルドだと思っていた」
lines.english: “Hmm. What has she gone and done, I wonder? She didn't seem like a bad kid, though. All right, question two. When you arrived here, you thought it was Gretagard.”

lines.japanese: 「え……あ、えっと、千歳さんもグレタガルドのことを知っているんですか」
lines.english: “What...? Um, Chitose, do you know about Gretagard too?”

lines.japanese: 「いやー、僕らの仲で『さん』はないでしょう。もっと気安く、シュウちゃんと呼んでおくれ」
lines.english: Come on, none of this ‘Chitose’ stuff between us. Loosen up and call me Shu, won't you?

lines.japanese: 「はい、分かりました千歳さん」
lines.english: “Yes. Understood, Chitose.”

lines.japanese: 「分かってねえだろオイィ！」
lines.english: “You didn't understand at all, dammit!”

lines.japanese: 「あはは」
lines.english: “Ahaha.”

lines.japanese: まだよく分からない部分は多いけど、千歳くんが兄弟だったら、家に帰るのが楽しいだろうなと思う。
lines.english: Much remained unclear, but if Chitose really were my brother, I thought going home each day would be fun.

lines.japanese: 「さて、時間もあまりないことだし、最後の質問をさせてもらおう。問３．ここには君の意思で来た」
lines.english: “Now, we don't have much time, so let me ask the final question. Question three. You came here of your own will.”
“What...?”

lines.japanese: 僕の意思。僕の意思でグレタガルドへ。そんな、僕は今までだって、召喚されたからこそグレタガルドの地へやってきたんだ。
lines.english: My own will. I had come to Gretagard of my own will? Impossible. Every time before, I had traveled to Gretagard because I was summoned.

lines.japanese: 「いや、おれは召喚されて……」
lines.english: “No. I was summoned...”

lines.japanese: 「ふうん」
lines.english: “I see.”

lines.japanese: 千歳くんはしばらく指の動きを止めて何か考えていたけれど、急にニッと口をいっぱいにして笑うと、ぽんと僕の肩に手を載せた。
lines.english: Chitose held his beckoning finger still and thought for a while. Then a broad grin suddenly filled his face, and he clapped one hand onto my shoulder.

lines.japanese: 「タカシ君、今すぐ向こうに帰んなさい」
lines.english: “Takashi. Go back over there right now.”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 言っている意味が分からなかった。
lines.english: I did not understand what he meant.

lines.japanese: 「あの、帰れって……ここから戻る時は、おれの意思じゃないんです」
lines.english: Um, when you say go back... I can't just leave here when I want to.

lines.japanese: 「ここがね、グレタガルドじゃないのは分かるよね」
lines.english: “You do understand that this isn't Gretagard, right?”

lines.japanese: 「はい、それはなんとなく」
lines.english: “Yes. I had gathered that much.”

lines.japanese: 「でもここに来た。何でだと思う？」
lines.english: “And yet you came here. Why do you think that is?”
“What?”

lines.japanese: それがさっぱり分からない。というよりも、ここがどこだかすら分からないから、聞いたのに。
lines.english: I had no idea. More to the point, I did not even know where this was. That was why I had asked.

lines.japanese: 「それはきっと、グレタガルドなんて本当は存在しないことに気がついたからだと思うよ」
lines.english: “I think it's because you've realized that Gretagard never really existed.”
“What...?”

lines.japanese: 「そんなこと……グレタガルドはありますよ……」
lines.english: “That can't be... Gretagard does exist...”

lines.japanese: 「ここが君の言っている場所なんじゃないかな。よろしくグレタガルド」
lines.english: “Perhaps this is the place you've been talking about. Hello, Gretagard.”

lines.japanese: 「そして、さよならグレタガルド。現実に、タカシ君のことを待っているひとがいるんでしょ」
lines.english: “And goodbye, Gretagard. There's someone waiting for you in the real world, isn't there?”

lines.japanese: 「おれのことを……おれのことを待っているひとは、グレタガルドにいるんです」
lines.english: “The people waiting for me... The people waiting for me are in Gretagard.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、実はおいちゃんがイーグルなのよ」
lines.english: “Ah. Well, the truth is, this old fellow here is Eagle.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ！」
lines.english: “What?!”

lines.japanese: イーグル……ってことは、このひとが僕の仲間ってことなのかな。
lines.english: Eagle... Did that mean this man was one of my companions?

lines.japanese: 「タカシ君、俺の手をしっかりと握りなさい」
lines.english: “Takashi. Take a firm hold of my hand.”

lines.japanese: 「手……ですか？」
lines.english: “Your hand...?”

lines.japanese: 「なんならハグしてもいいのよ。さあおいで」
lines.english: “You can hug me instead, if you like. Come here.”

lines.japanese: ハグの意味がよく分からなかった僕は、両手を広げた千歳くんの右手をがっしと両手で握った。たくましい、というほどではなかったけど、器用そうな、温かみのある手だった。
lines.english: I didn't really understand what he meant by a hug. Chitose spread his arms, and I grabbed his right hand firmly in both of mine. It wasn't exactly a big, rugged hand, but a nimble-looking one, warm to the touch.

lines.japanese: 「おっけー。落ちないようにしっかりと握ってよくお聞き」
lines.english: “Okay. Hold tight so you don't fall, and listen carefully.”

lines.japanese: 「グレタガルドに召喚されなかったのは、君がその世界は自分の作り上げたものだと気づいたからで……」
lines.english: “You weren't summoned to Gretagard because you realized that world was something you had created...”

lines.japanese: 「そしてここは君の中、自分自身の心の中ってことなわけ」
lines.english: “And this place is inside you. Inside your own mind, in other words.”

lines.japanese: 「おれの？」
lines.english: “Mine?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、残念ながらタカシ君じゃないの。えー、この世界の元々の持ち主は――」
lines.english: “Ah, but unfortunately, not Takashi's. Now, the original owner of this world is—”

lines.japanese: 「羽田ヨージ。グレタガルドで言えば、先代王コンドルになるのかな」
lines.english: “Yoji Haneda. In Gretagard terms, I suppose he'd be the former King Condor.”

lines.japanese: 「つまり、この世界の持ち主は彼であって、俺たちはそこから分裂した存在になるんだよね」
lines.english: “In other words, this world belongs to him, and the rest of us are selves who split away from him.”

lines.japanese: 「え、じゃあ、ここにいるおれは……」
lines.english: “Then... the me standing here is...”

lines.japanese: 「うん、本当の人格じゃないってことになるね」
lines.english: “Mm-hm. That would mean you aren’t the real personality.”

lines.japanese: 瞬間、何かのドッキリ番組のように床に穴が開いた錯覚を覚えた。遥か地下にまで自分が落ちる恐怖。
lines.english: In that instant, I felt as though a trapdoor had opened beneath me on some hidden-camera show. Terror seized me: the sensation of falling into unfathomable depths.

lines.japanese: その落ちる寸前、千歳くんが抱きついてきて、僕の落下を食いとめてくれた。意識はしてなかったけど、全身が総毛だって、冷や汗が一斉に吹きでた。
lines.english: Just before I fell, Chitose threw his arms around me and caught me. I had not noticed until then, but every hair on my body stood on end and cold sweat burst from every pore.

lines.japanese: 「……やっぱりハグしておけばよかった」
lines.english: “...I should've hugged you in the first place.”

lines.japanese: 僕が僕じゃない。この体が僕のものじゃないってどういうことだろう。
lines.english: I was not myself. What did it mean for this body not to be mine?

lines.japanese: 体に力が入らない。千歳くんに抱きしめられたまま、体重を預けることにした。
lines.english: All strength had left me. Still held in Chitose's arms, I let him bear my weight.

lines.japanese: 「落ち着いて。落ち着いて頭の中を整理しよう。はい、深呼吸～」
lines.english: Easy, easy. Let's get your thoughts straight. Okay, deep bre-e-eath.

lines.japanese: 「よし、じゃあぼちぼち話をしていこっかな。何も分裂した存在だから、いつかは消えるっていうんじゃないのよ」
lines.english: Okay, I guess I'll start explaining, little by little. Being split off doesn't mean you're definitely going to disappear someday.

lines.japanese: 「確かに基本人格はヨージ君のものだけど、どうも彼、二度と出てくる気はないみたいなんだよね」
lines.english: “The core personality may belong to Yoji, but apparently he has no intention of ever coming out again.”

lines.japanese: 「だから俺たちは――もう一人、隼人君って言うんだけど、彼と話しあって、今後について何度も考えたのよ」
lines.english: “So the two of us—there’s one other fellow, named Hayato—talked it over. We’ve thought again and again about what to do from here.”

lines.japanese: 「いま君が俺と話しているわけだけど、普通ならこうやって自己のもう一人格と話すなんてことは出来ないはずなんだよ。それを可能にしたのが、俺たちが≪面談≫と呼んでいる方法で――」
lines.english: “You're speaking with me now, but ordinarily one self shouldn't be able to sit down and talk to another self like this. What makes it possible is a method we call the Interview—”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、まあ、それはいいか。それで、俺たちの結論としては、タカシ君に表に立ってもらおうとその機会を待ってたのよ」
lines.english: “Ah, never mind that. Anyway, Hayato and I decided we wanted you to take over. We’ve been waiting for our chance.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、おれに？　どうしてですか？」
lines.english: “Me? Why?”

lines.japanese: 「どうしてって言われても困るんだけどねえ、まあ、身内でぐだぐだに争うよりは、潔く兄ちゃんに道を譲ろうじゃないかって、俺と隼人君の間では意見が一致してたわけね」
lines.english: Hard to say why, really. Hayato and I both figured it'd be better to step aside for our big brother than keep bickering forever inside the family.

lines.japanese: 「ただまあ、そのために、タカシ君が一人立ちする決意みたいなものを待ってたのよ。ほら、俺らが勝手に話しあってても、結局は君次第だもんね」
lines.english: But, well, we were waiting for you to make up your mind to stand on your own. I mean, no matter what the two of us decided between ourselves, it was up to you in the end.

lines.japanese: 「そんで今日やっとこ、タカシ君もグレタガルドが自分の偶像だってことに気がついてくれたからさ。だから、こうして自分自身――まあ、俺か。向きあうことが出来たんだよ」
lines.english: And then today, you finally figured out that Gretagard was an idol you made for yourself. That's why you were able to face yourself like this—or, well, face me, I guess.

lines.japanese: 「自分の……偶像？　グレタガルドのひとたちが？」
lines.english: “An idol... of my own making? The people in Gretagard?”

lines.japanese: グレタガルドのひとたちがいつも崇めていた、英雄の自分。本当は聖騎士ホークなんか居なくて、それに憧れていただけの自分だったのか……。
lines.english: The people of Gretagard had always worshiped me as their hero. But perhaps there had never been a holy knight Hawk. Perhaps I was only someone who longed to be him...

lines.japanese: 「タカシ君にも、必要なものが出来たってことでしょ。はは、まあこれから生きていくには大変だろうけど、まずは第一歩を踏みだしたことにおめでとう」
lines.english: “It means you’ve found something you need too, Takashi. Ha ha. Living from here on won’t be easy, but congratulations on taking your first step.”

lines.japanese: 「タカシ君の部屋の先に、洋間があるじゃない。そこに入って、机の引き出し開けてみるといい」
lines.english: “There's a Western-style room beyond yours, remember? Go in and open the desk drawer.”

lines.japanese: 「君が一人立ちするときのため、俺と隼人君からささやかな贈り物。ま、あまり期待はしないでね。あと無駄遣いすんなよ、風俗行くなよ、自分でも働けよ」
lines.english: “A modest gift from Hayato and me, for when you strike out on your own. Don't expect too much. And don't squander it, don't spend it at a brothel, and get a job yourself.”

lines.japanese: 一度に与えられた情報量の質量と物量に、僕は頭を常に整理し続けることだけでいっぱいだった。記憶の更新の繰りかえし。
lines.english: The sheer mass and volume of what I had been given left me capable of nothing but continually reorganizing my thoughts. Again and again, my memories rewrote themselves.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ……千歳くんや、その、他のひとたちはどうなるんですか」
lines.english: “Then... what will happen to you, Chitose? And to the others?”

lines.japanese: 「ははっ、やっさしーい」
lines.english: “Ha! So ki-i-ind.”

lines.japanese: 千歳くんは息をふっと上に向かって吹きだした。前髪がふわふわと揺れる。
lines.english: Chitose blew a breath upward. His bangs fluttered.

lines.japanese: 「その優しさはタカシ君の一番いいところだと思うなあ。まあ、良し悪しは時と場合によるけど……ああ、いや、質問に答えなくちゃね」
lines.english: I think that kindness is the best thing about you, Takashi. Though whether it's good or bad depends on the situation... Ah, no, I was supposed to answer your question.

lines.japanese: 「ほんとのこと言うと、俺にもどうなるかなんて分かんないのよ。お医者さんじゃあるまいし」
lines.english: “Truth is, I don’t know what’s going to happen either. I’m not a doctor.”

lines.japanese: 「そんでも、少しでもいい方向に考えた方がいいんじゃないかな。なに、元々は一つだったものが元に戻るってだけの話――タカシ君のままであるといいんだけどね」
lines.english: Still, don't you think we'd be better off looking at it positively? I mean, all that's happening is something that started as one is going back to being one again—I just hope you're still Takashi afterward.

lines.japanese: 「ま、そのためにも、自分の意思をしっかり保ってちょうだいってことかな。いまここに来たのも、なにか心が乱れてるからだろうし」
lines.english: “Well, I guess that means you need to hold on to your own will. You probably came here because something's been troubling you.”

lines.japanese: 「今まで苦労して、やっとこさ安定してきたとは思ってたんだけどなあ」
lines.english: “After all we'd been through, I thought things had finally begun to settle down.”

lines.japanese: 「何が原因なんでしょうか」
lines.english: “What do you think caused it?”

lines.japanese: 「えー、タカシ君の中で何かが変わったってことは間違いないと思うよ。それに、そろそろ何かが変わる兆候は出てたと思うんだよね。ね、そういうことでしょ？」
lines.english: Umm, I think it's pretty clear something inside you has changed. And I think there'd been signs for a while that something was about to change, too. Right? That's what this is, isn't it?

lines.japanese: 「え？　どうしたんですか？」
lines.english: “What? Is something wrong?”

lines.japanese: 「ああいや、そこの彼。こう、話に聞きいってるみたいだから、ふと声をかければ答えてくれるかなと思ったんだけど、やっぱ駄目じゃん」
lines.english: Oh, no, that guy over there. He looked like he was really listening to us, so I thought maybe he'd answer if I suddenly talked to him, but nope. Still nothing.

lines.japanese: 「あ、ああ……あの、良かったら会議に加わってくれませんか。おれも頭がいっぱいで……」
lines.english: “Oh... Um, if you'd like, could you join our discussion? My head is already overflowing...”

lines.japanese: 「んー、そこの彼ねえ、なに言っても返してくれないんだよね。かと言って、死神ってわけでもなさそうだすぃー……んん、ま、いっか」
lines.english: Mm, that guy over there never answers no matter what I say. Doesn't look like he's the Grim Reaper or anythiiing... Hmm. Ah, whatever.

lines.japanese: 「どのみち、何かが変わりはじめたことは確かなんだよ。だからね、これから――あ」
lines.english: “Either way, something has definitely started to change. So from now on—ah.”

lines.japanese: しゃんしゃんしゃん、しゃんしゃんしゃん
lines.english: Jingle, jingle, jingle. Jingle, jingle, jingle.

lines.japanese: 世界が少しずつ金色に包まれていく。これは……ここにいる時間が……。
lines.english: Gold spread little by little across the world. This meant... my time here was...

lines.japanese: 「多分、もう会うことはないかもね。ここでの記憶ってのは凄く曖昧だから、目覚めてすぐに俺の顔でも強くイメージすればいいよ」
lines.english: We probably won't see each other again. Memories of this place get really hazy, so as soon as you wake up, try to picture my face really clearly.

lines.japanese: 「すみません、おれ、ひとの顔を覚えるのが苦手で……」
lines.english: “I'm sorry. I've never been good at remembering faces...”

lines.japanese: 「言ってる場合かオイィ！」
lines.english: “This is no time to say that, dammit!”

lines.japanese: はは、最後まで面白いひとだったなあ。
lines.english: Ha ha. He had been funny to the very end.

lines.japanese: 意識が薄れていく中、一つ一つを整理して考える。
lines.english: As my awareness faded, I tried to sort through each thing he had told me.

lines.japanese: 自分をしっかり保つと言っていたけど、結局は僕という存在は最初からなかったってことだ。
lines.english: He had told me to hold fast to myself. Yet in the end, the person I called myself had never existed at all.

lines.japanese: 自分を保てなければどうなるんだろう。もうこの世に未練なんてないと思ってた。そのために残務処理の項目も作ってきた。
lines.english: What would happen if I failed to hold on? I had thought there was nothing left to bind me to this world. That was why I had made my list of Unfinished Business.

lines.japanese: 自分が自分じゃないまま消えるなんて嫌だ。
lines.english: I did not want to disappear without being myself.

lines.japanese: だけどもうグレタガルドにはいけないんだ。
lines.english: But I could never go to Gretagard again.

lines.japanese: じゃあ僕は……消えるしかないんじゃないか。
lines.english: Then perhaps... there was nothing left for me but to disappear.
